desc:
Catdoku is a puzzle that combines elements of Sudoku and Minesweeper. 
Every puzzle has one solution and it can be solved through logic without guessing.

How-to-Play:
There is one Cat in each color.
There is one Cat in each row and column.
Two Cats cannot touch, including diagonally.

🧩 Levels: Complete over 1,000 levels, 💰 earn coins, 🔥 set your best win streak! 
🧠 Ranked: Play against other players to see who can complete the same puzzle first.
📅 Daily Puzzles: Solve a daily puzzle that refresh every day.
